location_qualifier: Guadalcanal landing, beach not named, as corps artillery
current_activity: landing on Guadalcanal as corps artillery (batteries staggered through 30 January)
notes: Miller, ch. XV n. 24: soldiers and mules of A, B, Headquarters, and Service Batteries of the 97th Field Artillery Battalion, a 75-mm mule-pack unit, landed on Guadalcanal on 16, 27, and 30 January 1943 to serve as part of Corps artillery. The footnote does not assign each battery to a calendar day. The claim is dated to the first landing day and uses Lunga Point with precision 5 km because the beach is not named. Confidence 0.5: one official family.

location_qualifier: in support of the 161st Infantry passing through the 147th
current_activity: supporting the 161st Infantry's pursuit through the 147th lines
notes: Miller, ch. XV: on 6 February 1943, when the 161st Infantry passed through the 147th's lines to continue the north-coast pursuit, the 2nd Battalion, 10th Marines, the 97th Field Artillery Battalion, and Americal Division artillery were to support the 161st. The claim uses the Umasani River (the 161st's 6 February objective in C12955) as the supported zone, with precision 5 km. Confidence 0.5: one official family.
